mentions.name: Excel workbook input/output tabulation tool
mentions.description: A planned tool that takes unstructured Excel workbooks and adds a sheet tabulating the model's inputs and outputs, enabling bulk evaluation and retention of old results. It treats the workbook's cell arrangement as an ad hoc user interface for the model and gives subject matter experts an extra tool for working with their models.
mentions.problem: A lot of spreadsheet models are not set up for bulk evaluation or retaining old results.
mentions.audience: Subject matter experts who author spreadsheet models
mentions.source_excerpt: At the top of my list is taking unstructured workbooks and adding a sheet to tabulate inputs and outputs. A lot of spreadsheet models are not set up for bulk evaluation or retaining old results, and the peculiar arrangement of cells constitutes an ad hoc user interface for the model. I want to take that seriously as a programming environment for subject matter experts and give them an extra tool for working with their models.
